greeting: Hi! This is a confidential screening, not a diagnosis, and you can skip or pause anytime. How have you been feeling over the last two weeks?
crisis_escalation_message:
Thank you for telling me. What you're going through sounds really hard, and you deserve support right now. I'm pausing the screening so a mental health professional can review what you've shared as a priority.

If you feel you might act on these thoughts or are not safe, please reach out now:
- If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number now.
- Find a free, confidential crisis line in your country at https://findahelpline.com.
- Examples: 988 in the US (call or text), Samaritans 116 123 in the UK and Ireland, 112 for emergencies across the EU.

You don't have to go through this alone.
pause_message: Your progress is saved. Come back whenever you're ready and we'll pick up where you left off.
review_pending_message: Thanks, your answers are now with a clinician. If you ever feel unsafe, contact emergency services or a crisis line.

non_diagnostic_disclaimer: This is an initial screening summary of self-reported information. It is not a diagnosis and does not recommend any treatment or medication. A qualified mental health professional must review it. If you are in immediate danger or thinking about harming yourself, contact local emergency services or a crisis line right away.
